notes.title: Development News 2 - May 2025 Progress & What’s Ahead
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just a quick update to let you know that development is still moving. I've been working hard on a number of improvements and additions, and while not all of it may land in a single patch, it’s all part of the next big wave of updates coming this year.[b] The target to leave Early Access is November 2025. [/b]

Here’s what’s currently in progress:

[list]
[*] AI Pathfinding Rework – I'm improving how creatures navigate the environment to make encounters feel more dynamic and challenging. The monster getting stuck and walking through objects, as well as the late hits are not good enough for v1.0. These kinks will be smoothed out.

[*]Recoil & Weapon Improvements – Expect tweaks to gunfeel, recoil behavior, and overall weapon balance. Stronger kickbacks and more responsive weapons.

[*]UI Polish – Several parts of the interface are being refined for clarity and ease of use. It's far too clunky currently

[*]New Player Models – I'm adding the characters back in for better identity and immersion. Each one represents their class respectively.

[*]New Map & Monster – A brand-new map is on the way, along with a new monster to track. I have a few to choose from already complete, not sure which one I will add yet. I will keep you updated with this one.
[/list] 

Some of these changes may arrive in phases across multiple updates, but rest assured — I'm actively working on all of it. There will be more content before v1.0 launch also. This is just a list of what I'm currently working on.

Thanks again for sticking with me and being part of the journey. Your feedback and support continue to shape the game, please continue to leave your suggestions!

notes.title: a7.8.2 Patch
notes.content:
This is a small patch that just addresses some major input issues in the game. These issues were causing delay and unresponsiveness to inputs.
[list]

[*]Mouse smoothing is completely removed. You can expect an instant response to your inputs now.

[*]Weapon rotation lag is no longer extreme. It is now optimized for each weapon and operates smoother and more responsively.

[*]Aiming delay is removed entirely. Aiming is instant, as well as aim down sights on the weapons has been optimized.
[/list]
Thanks.

notes.title: a7.8.0 Update | New Score System, New Character Classes, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Truth Seekers - a7.8.0 Update Patch Notes[/h1]

[i][b][h3]New Content & Features:[/h3][/b][/i]

[h2]New Scoring System Implemented![/h2]
[olist]
[*]Meat on Trap: +5 points
[*]Monster Hit by Trap: +50 points
[*]Harvest Wolf: +15 points
[*]Monster Hit by Bullet: +10 points
[*]Item Crafted: +1 point
[*]Camera Recorded Monster: +10 points per second
[*]Tracked Monster: +25 points
[/olist]

[h2]New Playable Classes![/h2]
[list]
[b][*]Hunter – Equipped with a brand-new shotgun for better firepower.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/cfab61a0c7aca74d20fe98d19b798c886b32b9ea.png[/img]
[b][*]Camera Guy – Focused on recording evidence for high scores.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/18296ca68f9747578243249c4946edf3bf1666ff.png[/img]
[b][*]Tracker – Specializes in tracking the monster’s movements.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/d7a0b97a7adab74fa9fe289cfebafbc038b36a95.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]New Features & Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added stats page to track individual performance.
[*]Added identifying text below each inventory and hotbar item.
[*]Added variable pitch for monster screaming SFX for more variety.
[*]Added new blood particle effects for improved visual feedback.
[*]Extended monster hunt duration (waypoints increased from 13 to 20).
[*]Added 4:3 resolution support for better compatibility with older displays.
[*]Score breakdown now shows each player's contribution on the win/lose screen.
[*]Tutorial menu rewritten to better explain character roles and game objectives.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes & Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed monsters getting stuck while running at players during attack cycles. (New 30-second max attack timer added).
[*]Fixed wolves not despawning after being harvested.
[*]Monster AI tweaks for smoother pathing.
[*]UI & Sound Improvements
[*]Fixed new UI scaling issues across different resolutions.
[*]Tons of UI fixes for better clarity and usability.
[*]Added pickup sounds for all items.
[*]Networking & Stability
[*]Fixed cameras not working after placing five.
[*]Fixed score only updating for master client—now properly syncs across all players.
[*]Fixed loading screen not feeding correct level data to clients.
[*]Fixed handheld camera view distance to ensure proper footage capture.
[*]Fixed random crashes when loading a second time into a match.
[*]Fixed retry load scene not working for clients.
[*]Over 30+ miscellaneous bug fixes for improved stability.
[/list]

This update brings new gameplay depth, better balance, and tons of quality-of-life fixes. You may encounter bugs with the new features. Please report all the bugs in the settings menu under the bug report option, or join the discord! My DM's and general chat are always open! Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Development News 1
notes.content:
I want to start off by saying [b]no, I am not dead.[/b] I've been hard at work pushing for the a.7.8.0 update. This update is going to add a major change in the way the game is played in multiplayer, and create some even funnier scenarios!

[h1]So, What's Going to Change in a.7.8.0?[/h1]
I'm glad you asked! Here's a list of what you can expect:

[list]
[*][b]Added controls menu to see binds[/b]
[*][b]Fixed game crashing after playing a match(I found the issue, its related to the voice chat. It will be fixed[/b]
[*][b]Created a camcorder. This will live stream a video signal to the TV back at the base when held and turned on. You can replace your walkie talkie for this, but you cannot have both.[/b]

[i]This was the first test for the camcorder:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/ba384f728ab7cd505687e53cc0b9e8ffeb72b72b.png[/img]

[*][b]Added a score counter:
             -Bullets hit +5
             -Monster killed +1000
             -Beer and mushroom +15
             -item crafted +10
             -Player death +100
             -Wolf killed +50
             -Camera placed +50
             --Your score will show at the end of the match[/b]
[*][b]Added wolf pelt to drop on wolf harvest[/b]
[*][b]Added craftable wolf pelt hat. Gives +25 health pool increase (100>125 total health allowed)[/b]
[*][b]Show spectated player's current health[/b]
[*][b]Change dedicated server to US west[/b]
[/list]

[b]And that's just the beginning![/b] I'm constantly working to make the game better, funnier, and more engaging for everyone. I can't wait for you to experience all the hilarious moments and new strategies these updates bring to multiplayer. This update is on schedule to come out in the next few weeks.

Thank you all for your continued support and patience. Your feedback drives me to keep pushing forward, and I can't wait to hear your thoughts once a.7.8.0 drops. See you in the game!

notes.title: Delayed Release Information
notes.content:
[b][i][h1]The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly[/h1][/i][/b]
A few things happened just before launch that have led to a delay. Here are the steps I'm taking to resolve the issues and release in the coming week.

[h2][i]The Bad[/i][/h2]

I'm starting with the bad news: the game launch has been delayed from October 31st. Due to issues with the content survey, the game was blocked in certain parts of the world. I've been working with Steam to resolve this and ensure everything is ready for a smooth launch.

[h2][i]The Ugly[/i][/h2]

I'm not exactly sure of the exact launch date yet, but I can confirm it will be in the first week of November. Thanks for sticking with us, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

[h2][i]The Good[/i][/h2]

This is the best part of the update! The game is now ready for its Early Access launch! I also want to highlight an important feature that will be available on launch day:

[i][b][h3]Demo players and full-version players can play together on the Whispering Pines Wilderness map. Demo users have access to all features, but they are limited to that map only.
[/h3][/b][/i]

All features are fully functional, and after some closed testing, I can confirm that the new map is incredibly fun!

Thank you all for your patience and support as I work to bring this game to life. I'm excited for you to experience everything I've put into the Early Access launch, especially the Whispering Pines Wilderness map that allows both demo and full-version players to team up and explore together. I can’t wait to hear your feedback and see you in-game soon. Stay tuned for the official launch date and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: Mark Your Calendars, The Release Date Is Now Official!
notes.content:
[h1] Exciting News, Truth Seekers![/h1]

I am thrilled to announce that Truth Seekers will officially launch into Early Access on October 31st, 2024! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into the mysteries and hunt down urban legends on Halloween!

First, I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in the Steam Next Fest demo and others who are currently participating. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and it’s because of your support that I’m able to keep pushing the game forward. As a solo developer, hearing from players like you gives me the insight I need to create the best possible experience.

[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]

As a solo developer, I’ve chosen to launch Truth Seekers in Early Access so that I can work closely with all of you to fine-tune and perfect the game. With your help, I’ll be able to find and fix bugs, improve gameplay, and polish the mechanics before the full release. Your involvement is crucial in shaping the final version, and I’m excited to collaborate with the community to ensure Truth Seekers reaches its full potential.

There’s also more content to come! This Early Access launch is just the beginning. I have a lot of exciting features, hunts, and secrets planned for future updates. Your feedback during Early Access will help guide the direction of the game and ensure it evolves into something even more special.

[h1]Sneak Peek[/h1]
And lastly, I wanted to leave you all with a screenshot from the new map that will be released when the game goes into early access. Welcome to Frostpeak Summit Sanctuary! Who knows what creatures could be lurking around...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/f7820c0c5e12432ea3525456e7506f6c73c20669.jpg[/img]

Thank you again for your ongoing support, and I can’t wait for you to experience Truth Seekers when it launches on October 31st!

Stay tuned for more updates, and I’ll see you in the hunt!

notes.title: New Demo Features! | Crafting System
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m excited to share the latest updates for the game, including new features, improvements, and tons of bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience.

[h1][b]What's New:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Rifle Model Upgrade:[/b] The rifle now features a red scope at the end, making it easier to aim and hit your target.

[*][b]New Crafting System (50% Complete):[/b] The new crafting system is well underway. While it’s still a work in progress, the framework is fully laid out and ready for future updates.

[*][b]AI Bug Fixes:[/b] I've squashed tons of bugs related to monster and wolf AI, particularly around hitbox detection, making encounters smoother and more reliable.

[*] [b]Player Models:[/b] To simplify testing, I've temporarily removed all player models except for Female1. This will help streamline the process as I focus on core gameplay.

[*][b]Improved Player Handling:[/b] Significant improvements have been made to player handling and overall game feel, making movement and actions more responsive.

[*][b]Crouching Animation Fix:[/b] The crouching animation now works properly, adding to the realism and fluidity of character movement.

[*][b]New Crafting Items:[/b] Batteries, Duct Tape, Glass Bottles, and Cloth Strips have been added as spawnable items for crafting, expanding your survival toolkit.

[*][b]New Points of Interest (POIs):[/b] A few new POI locations have been added to the current map to make it feel less barren. These locations also spawn the new crafting items mentioned above.

[*][b]Lighting Overhaul:[/b] A major lighting overhaul has been implemented, enhancing the atmosphere and immersion.

[*]I[b]n-Game Bug Report Option:[/b] There’s now an in-game bug report option in the settings menu. If you encounter any issues, please report them directly through the game, and I’ll do my best to fix them ASAP!
[/list]

You can check out all the changes in detail in Devlog 02 and the Changelog window on the main menu.

Thanks for your continued support!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/XMEEhhWb
